description: This Java source file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the Delinquency API in the Fineract project, including response and request data structures related to delinquency ranges, buckets, tags, and actions.

classes.name: DelinquencyApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes representing Swagger API response and request schemas for delinquency-related endpoints.

classes.name: PostDelinquencyRangeResponse
classes.description: Response schema for posting a delinquency range, includes resourceId.

classes.name: PutDelinquencyRangeResponse
classes.description: Response schema for updating a delinquency range, includes resourceId and changes.

classes.name: DeleteDelinquencyRangeResponse
classes.description: Response schema for deleting a delinquency range, includes resourceId.

classes.name: PostDelinquencyBucketResponse
classes.description: Response schema for posting a delinquency bucket, includes resourceId.

classes.name: PutDelinquencyBucketResponse
classes.description: Response schema for updating a delinquency bucket, includes resourceId.

classes.name: DeleteDelinquencyBucketResponse
classes.description: Response schema for deleting a delinquency bucket, includes resourceId.

classes.name: GetDelinquencyTagHistoryResponse
classes.description: Response schema for retrieving delinquency tag history, includes id, loanId, delinquencyRange, addedOnDate, liftedOnDate.

classes.name: GetDelinquencyActionsResponse
classes.description: Response schema for delinquency actions, includes id, action, startDate, endDate, createdById, createdOn, updatedById, lastModifiedOn.

classes.name: PostLoansDelinquencyActionRequest
classes.description: Request schema for posting a delinquency action, includes action, startDate, endDate, dateFormat, locale.

classes.name: PostLoansDelinquencyActionResponse
classes.description: Response schema for posting a delinquency action, includes officeId, clientId, resourceId.
